headline_metrics.far_ceiling_interpretation: Observed candidate FAR (16.03%) is below the operational ceiling of 17.50%; the Wilson 95% upper bound (20.72%) does not establish that the population parameter is strictly below the ceiling.

efficiency_metrics.candidate_pages_definition: Pages belonging to the candidate module/section structurally routed prior to dense retrieval (search space presented to dense retriever), compared against total 23-page curriculum baseline.
efficiency_metrics.token_reduction_definition: Context tokens of candidate parent groups in routed module compared against total 14,800 tokens across all 36 parents in curriculum baseline.

paired_test.mcnemar_interpretation: Observed paired accuracy difference was +0.80 percentage points, with 6 improvements and 2 regressions; the paired difference was not statistically significant by McNemar's test.
paired_test.formal_non_inferiority_note: Formal non-inferiority was not established by McNemar alone; a one-sided paired risk-difference confidence bound is required.

construct_audit.classification: Category B: PageIndex-derived deterministic structural routing
construct_audit.document_indexing_engine: Genuine upstream pageindex.page_index_flash (PDF-native, 100% page coverage, 0 missing pages, 0 VRAM)
construct_audit.query_routing_engine: Deterministic regular expression and keyword matching logic mapping queries to structural outline nodes extracted by PageIndex Flash
construct_audit.scientific_interpretation: Experiment evaluates PageIndex-derived deterministic structural routing rather than native PageIndex agentic retrieval.
